subject: RStudio and Rattle Plots - rattle 2.6.27 r106

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: RStudio and Rattle Plots - rattle 2.6.27 r106
parts:
The beta version of rattle now displays plots within the RStudio plots pane if rattle is started up from within RStudio.

One advantage is that RStudio maintains a history of plots, making it easy to review all of the plots you've generated over a session. Can also easily export the plots.

Beta version can be installed from Togaware:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

or

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Turn on Advanced Graphics under Settings to generate ggplot2 versions of many plots - still under development so not yet the default option.

Regards,
Graham
